description: Resend codes for the pending email change after resend_after. Replaces previous codes, expires in 24 hours, and is limited to one resend per minute. Retrying the same op_key sends no additional email.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.
